Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026

CBDT has notified the Income-tax (Eighth Amendment) Rules, 2026, vide Notification No. 139/2026 dated 30 October 2026, introducing Rule 189A and new Form 112A for intimating the merger of registered non-profit organisations having the same or similar objects under the Income-tax Act, 2025.
Re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi – Assignment and Review of Lead Bank Responsibility

CBDT has proposed the Income-tax (Seventh Amendment) Rules, 2026, introducing Rule 281A and new Form 173A for furnishing information to claim exemption on interest income and capital gains from Government securities under Schedule IV of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026
Delegation of Compounding of certain Contraventions under FEMA, 1999 to Regional Offices of the Reserve Bank
Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Miscellaneous) Amendment Directions, 2026

CBDT Notification No. 133/2026 amends the 1988 notification to specify that Joint Commissioners (Appeals) and Additional Commissioners (Appeals) shall be subordinate to the jurisdictional Principal Chief Commissioner or Chief Commissioner of Income-tax.

CBDT has issued Notification No. 134/2026 dated 8 October 2026, notifying the Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026, which introduce a revised Form 161 for filing applications for waiver of penalty under section 440(2) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.

As per Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026, the due dates for ITR and Audit Report are extended as below: Due date for filing of Income Tax Returns for AY 2026-27 is extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 from 31st October 2026 to 21st November 2026" Accordingly, the Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 is extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 from 30th September 2026 to 21st October, 2026.

CBDT has issued Notification No. 120/2026 extending the registration deadline for Registered Valuers and Authorised Income-tax Practitioners to 31 March 2027 and introducing revised Forms 169 and 171.
CBDT has issued Notification No. 121/2026 extends TDS reporting requirements for non-resident property transactions and updates Forms 132 & 141.
CBDT has issued Notification No. 3 of 2026 notifying the Procedure for registration of reporting person/entity and submission of Form No. 98 as per rule 160 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026.
CBDT has issued Notification No. 114/2026 [F. No. 370142/18/2026-TPL], notifying the rules and prescribed forms under the Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026.
Offline utility of ITR-6 for AY 2026-27 is available now for filing.
